title: Lit by facing, a light stage
label: Light stage on a perforated board: a stepped dais in a ticked rail holds a clear pane, its rim lit by a key lamp at the back and a fill at the front; a probe carriage rides the rail, a plotter draws L and a dimmer sets rim.
caption: Two fixed lights, a key and a half-strength fill, light each point of the clear rim by how squarely its normal faces them. Move round the rim: the probe carriage rides the rail, its stylus on the rim, while the plotter's gantry tracks it; L is 1.00 facing the key, 0.50 facing the fill, and the rim adds 0.216 L + 0.03 of white.
